description: This file appears to be a C source file implementing the backend for managing Git references, including functions for reading, writing, locking, unlocking, pruning, and handling reflogs. It contains definitions for structures and functions to manipulate references stored as files, including support for loose and packed refs, reflog management, and concurrency control.

classes.name: ref_lock
classes.description: Represents a lock on a reference, including its name, lock file info, old object ID, and usage count.

classes.name: files_ref_store
classes.description: Extends ref_store to include file-specific reference storage details, flags, directories, and cache.

classes.name: ref_entry
classes.description: Represents a reference or subdirectory entry.
